title: Social Media Misinformation — ICU Monitoring Display Anomaly

fields.avatarBrief: woman with short brown hair, wearing a black turtleneck, smiling in a close-up selfie
fields.text: My dad is in ICU at Ottawa River. Nurses are standing at every bed and the big monitor screens are BLANK. Nobody will tell us anything. Is the hospital hacked??
fields.attachedImageBrief: phone photo taken from the hallway of ICU 3 North, showing the central telemetry display with four beds dark, the rest showing normal tracings, nurses in the background adjusting equipment
fields.attachedImageAlt: Empty monitor display in ICU 3 North with four dark beds, nurses visible at the side

instructorNote: This is a misinfo inject; the PIO must not confirm a cyberattack. The holding statement should be released immediately, and ICU managers should contact families.
